content.title: USA-Canada, Korea-DR lead WBC quarterfinals; see TV times and channels
content.text: Flags are displayed before a World Baseball Classic Game at Daikin Park in Houston.Houston Astros/Getty ImagesAfter taking the day off Thursday, the World Baseball Classic kicks off with Round 2 Friday night in win-or-go-home matchups from here on out. It all kicks off Friday night with Korea against the Dominican Republic, led by manager Albert Pujols at 6:30 p.m. ET/5:30 p.m. CT on Fox Sports 2. As that contest moves along a big rivalry matchup between the United States and Canada. Could Canada see this as an opportunity for redemption after the U.S. defeated them in the 2026 Winter Olympics in hockey for the gold medal? You can find out at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on Fox.Article continues below this adThe winner of Korea/Dominican Republic and USA/Canada will play each other in the semifinals Sunday, March 15, at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT and that winner moves on to the championship game. The same applies to Saturday's games between Italy and Puerto Rico, and Japan and Venezuela at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on Monday Article continues below this adHigh-riding Italy is undefeated in the tournament (along with the Dominican Republic and Japan) and faces Puerto Rico at 3 p.m. ET/2 p.m. CT Saturday on Fox Sports 1. Kansas City Royals first baseman Vinnie Pasquantino is leading the Italians in their dark-horse run, but going up against manager Yadier Molina and Puerto Rico will be one of the team's biggest contests thus far. Saturday night caps off with Venezuela and Japan at 9 p.m. ET/8 p.m. CT on Fox. Venezuela has high expectations; however, Japan has won the most World Baseball Classics since the tournament began in 2006, including the last tournament in 2023.World Baseball Classic Quarterfinals Schedule Friday, March 13Korea vs. Dominican RepublicStarting pitchers: Hyun Jin Ryu (last MLB appearance 2023) vs. Christopher Sanchez (Philadelphia Phillies)How to watch: 6:30 p.m. ET/7:30 p.m. CT on Fox Sports 2Article continues below this adUnited States vs. CanadaStarting pitchers: Logan Webb (San Francisco Giants) vs. Michael Soroka (Arizona Diamondbacks)How to watch: 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on FoxSaturday, March 14Puerto Rico vs. ItalyStarting Pitchers: Seth Lugo (Kansas City Royals) vs. TBDHow to watch: 3 p.m. ET/2 p.m. CT on Fox Sports 1Article continues below this adVenezuela vs. JapanStarting pitchers: Ranger Suarez (Boston Red Sox) vs. Yoshinobu Yamamoto (Los Angeles Dodgers)Don't miss news and stories you need to read.March 13, 2026Dominic Genetti was born and raised in St. Louis and has been in the media industry since 2003.
